summary_en: THE OITA BANK authorized acquisition of up to 700,000 shares (0.92% of outstanding shares) for maximum 1.5 billion yen via market purchases and ToSTNeT-3 between November 10–30, 2026, and concurrent cancellation of 1,200,000 shares (1.52% of pre-cancellation outstanding) scheduled for December 14, 2026.
title_en: Notice of Authorization of Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Planned Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On November 9, 2026, the board of THE OITA BANK authorized the acquisition of up to 700,000 ordinary shares, representing 0.92% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum total outlay of 1.5 billion yen. The acquisition period runs from November 10 through November 30, 2026, and will be executed via two methods: discretionary market purchases through the Tokyo Stock Exchange and ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange transactions. Concurrently, the bank announced the cancellation of 1,200,000 shares (1.52% of outstanding shares before cancellation) scheduled for December 14, 2026. Both actions align with the bank's shareholder return policy, aimed at enhancing profit distribution to shareholders and improving capital efficiency while advancing the bank's corporate value.
